title: Factory Droid: observed session JSONL event
description: One event under the Factory session/project transcript roots. This is a partial observational reference, not a vendor-certified or lossless ingestion schema. Unknown properties are allowed.

type.description: session_start, message, todo_state, compaction_state, or an unmodeled event.

id.description: session_start: session ID; other records: event ID.

timestamp.description: Recorded timestamp string; preserve original representation, parse only when valid.

role.description: Native user/assistant carrier role; results can use user role.

type.description: Content-block discriminator; unknown variants must remain reachable.

text.description: Text content when this block is textual.

thinking.description: Recorded thinking text, when present; not a guarantee of all model reasoning.

name.description: Exact tool name, including namespace when encoded here.

input.description: Native tool input, commonly an object; preserve original value.

tool_use_id.description: Identifier linking a result block to a tool_use block.

content.description: Result payload, either string, nested blocks, or another source-specific value.

is_error.description: Provider-recorded tool-result error flag; absence is unknown, not success.

messageIndex.description: Provider message index associated with todo state, not our normalized sequence.

summaryTokens.description: Recorded token count associated with summary.

removedCount.description: Number of removed records/messages as reported by source.

systemInfo.description: Opaque provider-specific payload. Preserve it; the inspected sources do not establish its complete schema.
